iPhone

  1. Scan the QR code and open the link in Safari
  2. Tap Share (square with arrow)

Android

  1. Scan the QR code and open the link in Chrome
  2. Tap the ⋮ menu (top right)
  3. Select Add to Home screen (or "Install app")
Before the festival: open CatNet once with an internet connection — after that it works offline.

Updates: new database versions appear at the same address; open the app once while online to receive them.
